name: WATeamInbox Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted team inbox for WhatsApp linked devices and Telegram bots; no software seat or message quota published.
watch_out: Open-source beta, not production-hardened by default. Unofficial WhatsApp linked-device integration risks restrictions or bans. Hosting, storage, backups, transactional email provider and channel costs are separate; email inbox integration is not yet available. Third-party whatsmeow is MPL-2.0.
